name: Piper PA-12 Super Cruiser / PA-14 Family Cruiser
variants: PA-12 Super Cruiser (108 hp Lycoming O-235)
summary: Three-seat development of the J-5 Cub Cruiser: a fully cowled, strut-braced Cub-style high-wing with a wide cabin and a bench seat in the rear.

wings: High wing braced by one strut per side
engines: Single flat-four fully enclosed in a smooth Cub-style cowl
fuselage: Wide three-seat cabin with a bench seat in the rear
Large side windows along the cabin
tail: Conventional horizontal tail with rounded tips

tellTales: Cub-like profile with a noticeably wider, deeper cabin
Fully cowled engine in front of a rounded Cub tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The PA-12 has a wider three-seat cabin and a fully enclosed cowl; the J-3 is a narrow tandem two-seater, often with cylinders partly visible.
The PA-12 has rounded wingtips and a rounded tail; the PA-18 has squared tips and a squared fin and rudder.
The PA-12 has a rounded Cub tail and a three-seat cabin; the Stinson 108 is a four-seater with a six-cylinder nose and a larger curved fin.
The PA-12 is a smaller fabric aircraft with a rounded tail; the 180 is an all-metal aircraft with a bigger cowl and angular fin.
